FEAT-5-S132.title: Allowlist Configuration and Registration Mechanism
FEAT-5-S132.description: Implement a centralized allowlist registry within tool_router that explicitly maps permitted tool names to their handlers and Pydantic schemas, preventing dynamic or implicit tool execution.

FEAT-5-S133.title: Core Dispatch Logic with Strict Validation Enforcement
FEAT-5-S133.description: Enhance tool routing logic to enforce strict Pydantic validation before execution, including rejection paths for invalid inputs and structured error responses returned to the chat loop.

FEAT-5-S134.title: Tool Routing Error Handling and Debug Logging
FEAT-5-S134.description: Integrate structured error handling and debug logging for tool routing failures, including invalid tool names, schema violations, and execution errors, with logs persisted via debug_logger.

FEAT-5-S135.title: Security Hardening for Unauthorized Tool Access
FEAT-5-S135.description: Implement safeguards to explicitly block any tool calls not present in the allowlist, including malformed tool_use payloads and injection attempts, ensuring compliance with GOV-004.

FEAT-5-S136.title: Tool Router Integration with Domain Services
FEAT-5-S136.description: Ensure routed tools correctly invoke underlying domain services (provider search, clinical trials, consent, unknown handling) and return normalized responses compatible with chat history injection.
